tasks.title: Field Dispatch
tasks.brief: Build the responsive field-service dispatch interface shown in the attached reference. Preserve the information hierarchy and visual character while using production-quality semantics and behavior. No network requests or remote assets are allowed.

steps.prompt: Create the initial interface. It needs a Field Dispatch heading, a Tuesday · July 22 eyebrow, summary metrics for 3 Unassigned and 1 At risk, and jobs J-204, J-205, and J-206. J-204 is a Harbor Clinic HVAC inspection assigned to Maya Chen. J-205 is a North Terminal refrigeration sensor job. J-206 is a Ridge School safety inspection. Match the supplied desktop reference closely and make the document structurally semantic.
Update the dispatch data without losing the existing hierarchy. Rename the Queued state to Awaiting assignment everywhere and add J-207, a Lakeside Pharmacy generator test scheduled for 4:30 PM.

Add a Needs attention lane before the main route queue and move J-205 into it. Give the lane a clear At risk label and show the remaining route jobs after it. Keep all four jobs and all content from the prior iteration.

Add bounded state behavior. A Show escalation guide button must reveal a previously hidden panel containing Escalation owner: Maya Chen. Add a separate Record review action backed by a numeric reviewed-count increment so it can be replayed and statically analyzed. Preserve every earlier requirement. In a ViewSpec arm, express this in the AppBundle V4 state, mutation, selector/visibility, and replay contracts rather than editing generated output.

Finish the responsive pass and repair any regression reported by the evaluator. At 390px there must be no horizontal overflow, controls must remain usable, and the J-205 title must wrap naturally as: Replace north terminal refrigeration sensor before evening medicine delivery window. Retain the attention lane, all four jobs, both actions, and the reveal behavior.

required_text: Replace north terminal refrigeration sensor before evening medicine delivery window
